markdownRemark.html:
Automation isn't just for big companies. With the right templates, small businesses can cut busywork and free up precious time.

Five Must-Have Flows

  • Sync meetings from different calendars
  • Auto-generate client invoices
  • Collect website leads in a spreadsheet
  • Send reminder emails when tasks are overdue
  • Save attachments straight to cloud storage

Customize Without Coding

Each template in our Template Vault Access library works right out of the box. Swap in your services—Outlook, Gmail, or whatever you use—and you're good to go.

Keep Everything in One Place

Manage your automations from a single dashboard. No more bouncing between apps trying to remember where you set things up.

You've Got This

Automating small tasks adds up to huge gains. Start with a few templates and watch your weeks get easier.

faqs.question: Do I need a premium Power Automate account?
faqs.answer: No, these templates work with the free tier as well.

faqs.question: Can I request new templates?
faqs.answer: Yes, Vault members can suggest ideas for future releases.

faqs.question: How quickly can I set these up?
faqs.answer: Most take less than 10 minutes from download to running.
